capabilities.streamLifecycle: CloseSend and send-side EOF preserve receive-side operation; receive completion and caller cancellation release resources once
capabilities.breakerPolicy: Explicit adaptive fields select the existing adaptive breaker; policy changes replace cached breakers; otherwise the three-failure threshold is preserved

capabilities.compatibilityBoundary: The reusable resolver keeps round_robin as its API default; generated native gRPC projects explicitly select P2C/EWMA from configuration.

capabilities.defaultWiring: Bindings use NewDefaultServer and NewDefaultClient; WithRules and WithClientRules attach live rules without changing generated function signatures
capabilities.scaffoldGovernance: Config rules are validated and shared through ServiceContext and the admin Manager; generated smoke tests verify rule updates affect real calls
capabilities.productionWiring: Production requires TLS and disabled reflection; token secrets are environment references; rule files load before serving; watchers and telemetry shut down with the application
capabilities.recoveryDrill: The generated check persists a candidate rule set, constructs a fresh manager to prove restart recovery, restores the original file, and constructs another manager to prove rollback.
capabilities.adminSecurity: Non-loopback admin listeners require authorization; probes remain public; external admin HTTP must be protected by a trusted network or TLS reverse proxy

incrementalScaffold.command: gofly rpc gen service.proto --scaffold --module example.com/service --dir service
incrementalScaffold.supported: Multiple services in one proto, nested and imported messages, unary and all streaming modes, additive method regeneration
incrementalScaffold.ownership: Business logic, config, service context, main and go.mod are create-only; protoc stubs and adapters are regenerated after complete path and ownership preflight
incrementalScaffold.dependencies: New modules require GOFLY_FRAMEWORK_PATH or an explicitly selected gofly module version; existing go.mod is preserved
incrementalScaffold.limitations: Incompatible method signature changes require manual business-code migration; separate proto scaffold applications must use separate output roots

capabilities.compatibilityBoundary: Generated production-native gRPC projects enable adaptive admission; direct NewDefaultServer callers remain unchanged unless WithAdaptiveLimiter is supplied. Runtime CPU sampling is process-local and fails open until a valid delta exists; distributed quotas remain out of scope.

capabilities.wiring: Load an include-imports FileDescriptorSet into NewGRPCTranscoderFactory, pass it to WithTranscoderFactory, and set route transcode.protocol to grpc
capabilities.contract: Uses dynamic protobuf messages and protojson for unary and server-streaming calls. Server streams emit ordered text/event-stream message events, initial metadata through filtered X-Gofly-Md headers, trailers through a terminal trailers event, and post-commit failures through an error event. Request cancellation closes the gRPC stream.
capabilities.limitations: Client-streaming and bidirectional-streaming methods return Unimplemented pending a separate duplex protocol decision. A server stream is bounded by the existing route or gateway timeout and waits for its first message before committing HTTP 200 so pre-stream gRPC failures retain HTTP status mapping. TLS is explicit via client options. HTTP-RPC routes retain their existing transport. Drain HTTP requests before closing the gateway.
